description: Gridfinity-compatible drawer organiser: a 15 × 10 grid covering a 630 × 424 × 69 mm drawer, built from six interlocking 5×5 baseplate tiles, plus an optional side filler strip for narrower grids, a 5×5 storage bin, a 10×5 bin split into two bed-sized halves, every layout container downloadable whole — and, where one exceeds the print bed, as pre-split bed-sized pieces whose seams are offset from the baseplate tile seams so each piece straddles a grid join (left container excepted) — and a full-drawer assembly preview showing a fitted set of nine containers: a full-depth 3×10 bin down the left, three 4×6 bins across the back row, and a 5×4, two 3×4s, a 1×3 and a 1×1 across the front, the four against a side wall flaring out to follow the drawer walls, and the back-centre bin's front half fitted with the divided half piece.
printing_notes: Baseplate tiles and bins all print flat on the bed with no supports.
Baseplate seams: do not press tiles together in-plane. Hold the new tile above the plane and lower it onto its neighbours so the edge tabs drop into their slots.
Back row of the drawer: use drawer_baseplate_5x5_back, which omits the rear tabs so the assembled grid stays 420mm deep with a flat back edge.
Side fillers are optional: the 15 x 10 grid fills a 630mm drawer edge to edge. Only print drawer_filler if your drawer is wider than 630mm, setting fill_w to (width - 630) / 2 in the customizer.
The outermost +X tabs on the right-hand tile column mate with nothing and add 1.8mm to the assembled width. If the drawer is tight, clip them flush with side cutters.
Split bins: print two drawer_bin_10x5_half, rotate one 180 degrees about Z, seat both on a baseplate to align them, then glue the flat faces with CA.

Containers over A1's 250mm bed print as pre-split pieces (drawer_container_left_front/_back, drawer_container_back_4x6_half, drawer_container_back_4x6_right_front/_back) with seams offset from the baseplate tile seams so each piece straddles a grid join. Left container only splits on the seam (5 cells max per piece). Seat pieces on the assembled baseplate to align, then butt-glue cut faces with CA.

The left container's two pieces are mirror images - print drawer_container_left_front and drawer_container_left_back, one each; unlike drawer_bin_10x5_half, one piece cannot be rotated to serve as the other.

drawer_container_front_5x4, drawer_container_front_3x4, drawer_container_front_1x3 and drawer_container_front_1x1 fit the bed whole - print the whole-container file, no pieces needed. Print two drawer_container_front_3x4: the front row uses it at columns 9-11 and 12-14.
drawer_container_back_4x6_half serves both unflared back-row containers - print four (two per container, one of each pair rotated 180 degrees about Z).
The back-right container's two pieces are flared, so they are mirror images - print drawer_container_back_4x6_right_front and drawer_container_back_4x6_right_back, one each.

drawer_container_back_4x6_half_divided is the same piece as drawer_container_back_4x6_half with five upright dividers inside, splitting the width into six equal segments; it prints the same way (floor down, no supports) and seats on the same baseplate cells. Mix and match - print two divided halves for a fully divided container, or one of each. The assembly preview fits one divided half into the front half of the back-centre container, open glue face towards the drawer back.
